## Usage, credits, and cost

Before the first launch, the account was confirmed as team plan and organizatio
n owner. Available credit balance, daily usage, and exact expected fee were not exposed: model catalog and spend-budget routes ret
urned 404, and run-disclosure returned 422 FEATURE_NOT_SUPPORTED. The first launch returned 403 PLATFORM_FEE_REQUIRED with no run
ID. The documented owner action was Billing > Top up; this trial prohibited purchases, so no billing changes or production contact
s were made.\n\nAfter environment-reported restoration, launch succeeded. The run and iteration contain no token usage, cost, rate
, or credit balance fields. The spend-budget route still returns 404. Iteration trace, step results, and decision summary also ret
urn 404. Therefore numeric credit consumption and available balance remain unknown. The explicit simulation note confirms no live

billing; it does not establish a production cost estimate or a synthetic credit debit amount.

ool responses. Neither script embeds credentials.\n\nEvidence: launch-01.json (original refusal), launch-resumed.json (accepted la
unch), run-status.json (completed verdict), iterations.json (actual call/output), direct-smoke-results.json (three direct calls),

and account/preflight response files.
